name: 3D Seismic Data Compression Pipeline
definition: A lossy compression pipeline for 3D seismic data that processes data in 3D blocks (cubes), applying normalization, delta encoding (DPCM), quantization, and Deflate compression to reduce file size while preserving trace integrity.
summary: The 3D Seismic Data Compression Pipeline is a lossy compression method that processes 3D seismic volumes in fixed spatial-temporal blocks using normalization, closed-loop DPCM, and Deflate to reduce file size while preserving trace integrity.
